# GEO Jacking

> Practical, white-hat guidance on AI visibility: how to stack SEO, AEO and GEO
> so that answer engines and large language models retrieve, cite and recommend
> your pages. Every technique published here is disclosed, reproducible and
> compliant with search and AI platform guidelines.

GEO Jacking is a free reference site. It defines the SEO → AEO → GEO → AI visibility
stack, explains what each layer actually does, and gives implementation detail for
structured data, retrievable content structure, entity building and measurement.
There is no paywall, no login, and no gated content. The term "GEO Jacking" was
coined by LogicBomb Media (https://lbm.co), the digital agency that built and
maintains this site.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-07

## Core guides

- [What is GEO Jacking?](https://geojacker.com/what-is-geo-jacking): Definition of GEO Jacking, the four-step method, and the ethical boundary.
- [The AI visibility stack](https://geojacker.com/ai-visibility-stack): How SEO, AEO and GEO layer to produce AI visibility, and how to diagnose which layer is failing.
- [SEO foundations](https://geojacker.com/seo-foundations): The technical SEO baseline AI retrieval depends on: crawl access, rendering, indexation, internal links.
- [Answer engine optimization](https://geojacker.com/answer-engine-optimization): How to structure passages so retrieval systems can extract them as standalone answers.
- [Generative engine optimization](https://geojacker.com/generative-engine-optimization): What GEO is, what the foundational KDD 2024 study measured, and how to apply it honestly.

## Implementation

- [Structured data for AI](https://geojacker.com/structured-data-for-ai): Practical JSON-LD patterns, a linked entity graph, and the limits of schema for AI visibility.
- [llms.txt, honestly](https://geojacker.com/llms-txt): Evidence-based assessment of llms.txt: low crawler usage, no major adoption, still cheap to ship.
- [Get cited faster](https://geojacker.com/get-cited-faster): Entity building, third-party mentions and the difference between being cited and being recommended.
- [The 30-day playbook](https://geojacker.com/30-day-playbook): Week-by-week execution plan: baseline, restructure, mark up, build entity signals.
- [Measure AI visibility](https://geojacker.com/measure-ai-visibility): Prompt panels, server log analysis and AI referral tracking — measurement you can run yourself.

## Reference

- [White-hat rules](https://geojacker.com/white-hat-rules): The ethical boundaries of GEO Jacking and why manipulative AI-visibility tactics fail.
- [Glossary](https://geojacker.com/glossary): Forty AI visibility, GEO and AEO terms with one-sentence definitions.
- [FAQ](https://geojacker.com/faq): Twenty direct answers to the most common questions about AI visibility, GEO and AEO.
- [About](https://geojacker.com/about): What this site is, how its claims are sourced, and how to cite it.
